caption:
Netflix finally cracked the Indian streaming market by doing what any local TV channel has done for decades. Turns out premium global originals are great, but unscripted drama brings in the big numbers. Would you rather watch prestige cinema or reality TV chaos? Let us know below. 📺🍿

@netflix_in

post.news: Netflix India grew revenue 18% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026, driven by reality shows like Lock Upp and deals for MTV Roadies.
post.take: Netflix spent years preaching high art before realising India just wants people screaming at each other on television.
post.insight: Growth in new markets requires brands to adapt their product line to local consumer preferences instead of forcing urban formulas.
